52501.commentary: (VINa) muggasūpo māsasūpo'ti ettha kulatth'ādīhi katasūpā'pi saṅgahaṃ gacchanti'y'evā'ti mahāpaccariyaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sūpo nāma dve sūpā, muggasūpo, māsasūpo. hatthahāriyo samasūpako piṇḍapāto paṭiggahetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sūpaññ'eva bahuṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

52502.commentary: (MNa) mās'ācitaṃ maññe'ti māsabhattaṃ bhuttassa kucchi viya māsapūritapasibbako viya tintamāso viya cā'ti attho. (ANa) mās'ācitakaṃ maññe'ti ettha pana mās'ācitaṃ nāma tintamāso. yathā tintamāso garuko hoti, evaṃ garuko'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāva'd'atthaṃ pāripūriṃ. tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño mās'ācitaṃ maññe. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.

tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭham'anupaviṭṭho. atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho me kucchi garugaro viya mās'ācitaṃ maññe'ti.
ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāva'd'atthaṃ pāripūriṃ. tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño mās'ācitaṃ maññe. hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.

tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭham'anupaviṭṭho. atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho me kucchi garugaro viya mās'ācitaṃ maññe'ti.

52504.commentary: (VINt) mās'ātikkantan'ti akālacīvare uppanne ūnassa pāripūriyā saṅghagaṇ'ādito satiyā paccāsāya māsam'ekaṃ parihāro labbhati, taṃ māsaṃ atikkantaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, akālacīvaraṃ mās'ātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti

52506.meaning1: occurring monthly; related to a month

examples.text: iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

52507.meaning1: so many months old; within so many months; -monthly
52507.commentary: (VINa) dumāsikaṃ vā duv'aṅgulaṃ vā'ti ettha sace kesā antodvemāse dv'aṅgulaṃ pāpuṇanti, antodvemās'eva chinditabbā.

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dumāsikaṃ vā duv'aṅgulaṃ vā'ti.

52508.meaning1: consisting of months; with months; related to months

examples.text: yaṃ kho pana, rājañña, mānussakaṃ vassasataṃ, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ eso eko rattin'divo, tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso, tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo, tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.

52510.meaning1: one month remaining; one month left (of)
52510.commentary: (VINa) māso seso gimhānan'ti catunnaṃ gimhamāsānaṃ eko pacchimamāso seso.

examples.text: māso seso gimhānan'ti, bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo

52511.meaning1: definitely don't!; you must certainly not!

examples.text: māssu, bho satta, puna'pi evarūpam'akāsī'ti. aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu, aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu, aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.
so samaṇ'uddeso bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
m'āhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, n'atthi attakāro, n'atthi parakāro'ti. m'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.

52515.commentary: (SNPa) puramāhissatin'ti māhissatināmikaṃ puraṃ, nagaran'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tañ'ca nagaraṃ paviṭṭhā'ti adhippāyo, evaṃ sabbattha.

examples.text: dantapuraṃ kāliṅgānaṃ, assakānañ'ca potanaṃ, māhissati avantīnaṃ, sovīrānañ'ca rorukaṃ.
aḷakassa patiṭṭhānaṃ, purimāhissatiṃ tadā, ujjeniñ'cā'pi gonaddhaṃ, vedisaṃ vanas'avhayaṃ.

52516.meaning1: may there not be; don't let there be

examples.text: yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehi, pacchā te m'āhu kiñcanaṃ, majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi.

kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.
sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā, māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno, ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā, vicinanti brahāvane.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

52518.meaning1: small hall; lodge; sometimes used as a sīma
52518.commentary: (APAa) visāle māḷake ṭhito'ti parisuddha-paṇḍara-pulinatal'ābhirāme vipule māḷake ṭhito.

examples.text: āhutiṃ yiṭṭhu'kāmo'haṃ, paṭiyādetvāna bhojanaṃ, brāhmaṇe paṭimānento, visāle māḷake ṭhito.

atha naṃ so thero jetavanaṃ netvā sahatthena, nhāpetvā māḷake ṭhapetvā pabbājetvā nivatthapilotikakhaṇḍena saddhiṃ naṅgalaṃ māḷakasīmāyam'eva rukkhasākhāyaṃ ṭhapāpesi. so upasampannakāle'pi naṅgalakulatthero'tv'eva paññāyi.

52519.meaning1: (gram) mi; verbal ending of the present tense 1st person singular

examples.text: 482, 508. dā'd'antass'aṃ mi mesu.
asa'icc'etāya dhātuyā mi ma'icc'etesaṃ vibhattīnaṃ mhi mh'ādesā honti vā, dhātv'antassa lopo ca. amhi, amha, asmi, asma.

52520.meaning1: (gram) mi suffix; verbal ending of the present tense 1st person singular

examples.text: akāro dīgham'āpajjate hi mi ma'icc'etesu vibhattīsu. gacchāhi, gacchāmi, gacchāma, gacchāmhe. mikāraggahaṇena hivibhattimhi akāro kvaci na dīgham'āpajjate. gacchahi.

52521.commentary: (NIDD2) migo'ti dve migā, eṇimigo ca pasadamigo ca.

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvus'ābbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye
sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā
tatra sudaṃ āyasmā raṭṭhapālo thullakoṭṭhike viharati rañño korabyassa migacīre.

52527.meaning1: type of deer; species of deer; (comm) herd of deer

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, nevāpiko nivāpaṃ nivapati migajātānaṃ, imaṃ me nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ migajātā paribhuñjantā dīgh'āyukā vaṇṇavanto ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ yāpentū'ti.

52528.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; son of Visākhā
52528.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
52528.commentary: (THa) kā uppatti? ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikāro tattha tattha bhave puññāni upacinanto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ visākhāya mahāupāsikāya putto hutvā nibbatti, migajālo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi.
52528.notes: Theragāthā verses 417-422 (TH6.8, TH217) are attributed to him.

examples.text: nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiyavihārī'ti vuccati.

52530.meaning2: Chapter 7 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

52532.meaning1: name of a park outside Bārāṇasī

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante isipatane migadāye.

52533.meaning1: name of a park outside Susumāragira
52533.commentary: (MNa) migadāye'ti taṃ vanaṃ migapakkhīnaṃ abhayadinnaṭṭhāne jātaṃ, tasmā migadāyo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavāḷaputtagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.

52534.meaning1: deer park keeper; deer forest ranger
52534.meaning2: deer park keeper; deer forest ranger

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho migadāyapālaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma dāyapāla, bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā khaṇḍañca rājaputtaṃ tissañca purohitaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi

52535.meaning1: beasts and birds; animals and birds
52535.commentary: (JAa) migapakkhīsū'ti sabbacatuppada-sakuṇānaṃ abhayaṃ dento tesu dhammaṃ carati nāma.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.
dhammaṃ cara mahārāja, migapakkhīsu khattiya, idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.

52536.commentary: (SNa) migapathakan'ti evaṃnāmakaṃ attano bhogagāmaṃ. so kira ambāṭak'ārāmassa piṭṭhibhāge hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena citto gahapati migapathakaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
orabbhikā sūkarikā, macchikā migabandhakā, corā ca vajjhaghātā ca, ye c'aññe pāpakammino, dak'ābhisecanā te'pi, pāpakammā pamuccare.

52540.meaning1: become like a deer; (comm) living without expectation
52540.commentary: (MNa) migabhūtena cetasā viharantī'ti apaccāsīsanapakkhe ṭhitā hutvā viharanti. migo hi pahāraṃ labhitvā manuss'āvāsaṃ gantvā bhesajjaṃ vā vaṇatelaṃ vā labhissāmī'ti ajjhāsayaṃ akatvā pahāraṃ labhitvā'va agāmakaṃ araññaṃ pavisitvā pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ heṭṭhā katvā nipatitvā phāsubhūtakāle uṭṭhāya gacchati. evaṃ migā apaccāsīsanapakkhe ṭhitā. idaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ migabhūtena cetasā viharantī'ti.

examples.text: ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā te taṃ pahāya app'ossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.
dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, urabbhānaṃ sataṃ urabbhabhūtānaṃ… ajānaṃ sataṃ ajabhūtānaṃ… migānaṃ sataṃ migabhūtānaṃ… kukkuṭānaṃ sataṃ kukkuṭabhūtānaṃ… sūkarānaṃ sataṃ sūkarabhūtānaṃ…

52543.meaning2: hare-deer; hoofed animal of the size of a cat (Sinh mīninnā)

52544.meaning1: king of the beasts; lord of the animals; epithet of a lion

examples.text: sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.
tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkamati. ye kho pana te, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīhassa migarañño nadato saddaṃ suṇanti, te yebhuyyena bhayaṃ saṃvegaṃ santāsaṃ āpajjanti.

52545.meaning1: auspicious marks of deer; (comm) auspicious marks of all animals

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… kaṇṇikālakkhaṇaṃ kacchapalakkhaṇaṃ migalakkhaṇaṃ iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti
migaluddo pure āsiṃ, araññe kānane ahaṃ, disvāna taṃ devadevaṃ, tiṇamuṭṭhiṃ adās'ahaṃ.

52548.commentary: (THIa) so dāni migaluddako'ti so idāni migaluddehi saddhiṃ sambhogasaṃvāsehi migaluddo māgaviko jāto.

examples.text: laṭṭhihattho pure āsi, so dāni migaluddako, āsāya palipā ghorā, n'āsakkhi pāram'etave.

tass'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahato migasaṅghassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo. so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ vivareyya, pidaheyya kummaggaṃ, ūhaneyya okacaraṃ, nāseyya okacārikaṃ.
eko'va indo asure jināti, eko'va seno hanti dije pasayha, eko'va byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañ'hi tādisaṃ.
dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu satt'āhaṃ satth'antarakappo bhavissati. te aññam'aññamhi migasaññaṃ paṭilabhissanti. tesaṃ tiṇhāni satthāni hatthesu pātubhavissanti.
so varaṃ varaṃ migasaṃghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam'eva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyan'ti.

52553.meaning1: name of a female lay disciple

52554.meaning1: name of a female lay disciple

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho migasālā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
odahi migavo pāsaṃ, n'āsadā vākaraṃ migo, bhutvā nivāpaṃ gacchāma, kandante migabandhake'ti.
sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.

52562.commentary: (ANa) migāranattā'ti migāraseṭṭhino nattā. (VINa) sāḷho'ti tassa nāmaṃ, migāramātuyā pana nattā hoti, tena vuttaṃ migāranattā'ti

examples.text: atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā sāṇo ca sekhuniyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

52563.commentary: (MNa) migāramātupāsādo ti visākhāya pāsādo. sā hi migārena seṭṭhinā mātuṭṭhāne ṭhapitattā migāramātā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ dāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ visākhā migāramātā
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.

52564.meaning1: name of a monastery outside Sāvatthī, built by Visākhā

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde
sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubb'ārāmo migāramātupāsādo ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.
aṭṭha micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo micchāsati, micchāsamādhi.
micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā

52571.commentary: (DNa) micchattaniyato'ti micchāsabhāvo hutvā niyato. niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ ānantariyakammass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā

52574.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: yañ'ca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañ'ca atidhāvanti yañ'ca loke saccasammataṃ tañ'ca atidhāvanti. tasmā tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ micchā'ti vadāmī'ti.

yadi, bhante nāgasena, tathāgatena bhaṇitaṃ, abyāvaṭā tumhe, ānanda, hotha tathāgatassa sarīrapūjāyā'ti, tena hi, pūjetha naṃ pūjaniyassa dhātuṃ, evaṃ karā saggamito gamissathā'ti yaṃ vacanaṃ, taṃ micchā.
mātari pitari c'āpi, yo micchā paṭipajjati, tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake, bahuñ'ca so pasavati, apuññaṃ tādiso naro.
methunam'anuyuttassa, mussate vā'pi sāsanaṃ, micchā ca paṭipajjati, etaṃ tasmiṃ anāriyaṃ.

52579.meaning1: with wrong livelihood; having a wrong mode of living

examples.text: pare micchāājīvā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāājīvā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāājīvassa purisapuggalassa sammāājīvo hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvāyāmassa purisapuggalassa sammāvāyāmo hoti parikkamanāya

52580.meaning1: wrong livelihood; wrong mode of living

examples.text: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāājīvo.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchākamm'anto? pāṇ'ātipāto, adinn'ādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchākamm'anto.

kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

52582.meaning1: undertaking wrong action; with wrong behaviour

examples.text: pare micchākamm'antā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammākamm'antā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāvācassa purisapuggalassa sammāvācā hoti parikkamanāya, micchākamm'antassa purisapuggalassa sammākamm'anto hoti parikkamanāya
dusse pana akkante, buddhānaṃ adhikāraṃ katvā patthitapatthitaṃ labhantī'ti loke anussavo, mayā ca mahā-abhinīhāro kato, na ca puttaṃ labhāmi, tucchaṃ idaṃ vacanan'ti micchāgahaṇaṃ gaṇheyya.
kāmesumicchācāro akusalaṃ

52585.meaning1: dependent on misconduct; due to misconduct

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena kāmesu micchācārī hoti, kāmesu micchācārapaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

52586.meaning1: who misbehaves oneself (regarding); who behaves wrongly (with)

examples.text: kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi

katame dasa dhammā pahātabbā? dasa micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇaṃ, micchāvimutti. ime dasa dhammā pahātabbā.

52590.meaning1: with incorrect understanding; with wrong wisdom
52590.commentary: (MNa) ettha ca micchāñāṇan'ti pāpakiriyāsu upāyacintāvasena pāpaṃ katvā sukataṃ mayā'ti paccavekkhaṇākārena ca uppanno moho veditabbo, tena samannāgatā puggalā micchāñāṇī.

examples.text: pare micchāñāṇī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāñāṇī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.

52591.commentary: (MNa) micchā pāpikā viññugarahitā etesaṃ diṭṭhī'ti micchādiṭṭhī, kammapathapariyāpannāya n'atthi dinnan'tiādivatthukāya, micchattapariyāpannāya aniyyānikadiṭṭhiyā ca samannāgatā'ti attho.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi pubbaṅ'gamā hoti? micchādiṭṭhiṃ, micchādiṭṭhī'ti pajānāti, sammādiṭṭhiṃ, sammādiṭṭhī'ti pajānāti, s'āssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.
atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.

52592.meaning1: having wrong view; with incorrect belief
52592.commentary: (MNa) micchā pāpikā viññugarahitā etesaṃ diṭṭhī'ti micchādiṭṭhī, kammapathapariyāpannāya n'atthi dinnan'tiādivatthukāya, micchattapariyāpannāya aniyyānikadiṭṭhiyā ca samannāgatā'ti attho.

examples.text: pare micchādiṭṭhī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammādiṭṭhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchādiṭṭhissa purisapuggalassa sammādiṭṭhi hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsaṅkappassa purisapuggalassa sammāsaṅkappo hoti parikkamanāya

52593.meaning1: who has wrong view; who holds a false belief

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti.
saṭhassa sāṭheyyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti, māyāvissa māyā appahīnā hoti, pāp'icchassa pāpikā icchā appahīnā hoti, micchādiṭṭhikassa micchādiṭṭhi appahīnā hoti

52595.meaning1: undertaking volitional action based on wrong view; performing deeds due to wrong beliefs
52595.commentary: (VINa) micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā'ti micchādiṭṭhivasena samādinnanānāvidhakammā, ye ca micchādiṭṭhimūlakesu kāyakammādīsu aññe'pi samādapenti.

examples.text: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.

52596.meaning1: because of undertaking actions based on wrong view

examples.text: samaṇo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā micchādiṭṭhiko micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.

52599.meaning1: dependent on wrong view; due to incorrect belief
52599.commentary: (SNa) micchādiṭṭhipaccayāpī'ti diṭṭhisampayuttā vedanā'pi vaṭṭati. diṭṭhiṃ upanissayaṃ katvā uppannā kusal'ākusalavedanā'pi vaṭṭati vipākavedanā'pi.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena micchādiṭṭhi hoti, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
